instruction: Create local folders in Thunderbird for URGENT and FOLLOWUP.

metadata.explanation: Task requires creating two local folders (URGENT and FOLLOWUP) in Thunderbird. The evaluator reuses the existing check_list metric function to verify that both the folder files and .msf index files exist for both folders using regex patterns.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly extracts state: ls -R on Thunderbird Local Folders directory captures both folder directories and .msf index files
Complete coverage: Checks all requirements - verifies both URGENT and FOLLOWUP folders with their corresponding .msf files (4 patterns total)
Regex patterns are semantically correct: Patterns distinguish between folder directories (URGENT/?) and .msf files (URGENT.msf) using word boundaries and negative lookahead
Appropriate metric function: check_list reads file line-by-line and verifies all expected regex patterns match, returning 1.0 only if all 4 patterns found
Correct data flow: Postconfig executes ls -R, saves to cache file, get_cache_file retrieves it, check_list validates patterns against rules
Postconfig is appropriate: Filesystem state is persistent after folder creation, no UI reopening needed
